en.text:
Hold [Reload] to consume up to <heavy/> 9 Ammo from reserves and <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine, activating 'Quantum Nova'. 

The duration of Quantum Nova depends on the amount of ammo consumed. Buff lasts for 4|8|14|20 seconds upon consuming 1|3|6|9 reserve ammo.

While active, this gun applies a <void/>Strong Weaken (30%) that lasts for 5 seconds on hit. 

Timer is paused while stowed.
